sam: Hi team  I finalized my divorce yesterday. Need to remove my ex-spouse from benefits and figure out if Im owed any premium refund for the months after we separated. What do I need to do?

nina - People Ops: Sorry to hear that, Sam. Divorce is a QLE. Please upload the divorce decree (final judgment) to the Life Event Enrollment form on the benefits portal or email benefits@redwood.com with subject "QLE - divorce - [Sam Lastname]". We have 30 days from the decree to update coverage.

sam: I uploaded the decree and marked the effective removal date as 2026-10-01 (we separated in July and Ive been paying spouse premiums since then). Can we get the coverage removed retro to Oct 1 and refund premiums charged in Aug/Sep?

kevin - Benefits Admin: We can remove the dependent effective the date you request within the 30-day window, but carriers handle premium adjustments differently. If removal effective date is 2026-10-01 we can stop future deductions, and we will request retro premium credits from the carriers for Aug/Sep if carrier allows.

 dylan - Payroll: For any premium refunds that come back from the carrier as credits, payroll can process a refund or a payroll credit. If the carrier denies retro premium credits, we can only stop deductions going forward; we do not un-withhold taxes already processed unless theres a carrier adjustment. Ill hold until Kevin confirms carrier response.

 sam: Also need to confirm whether ex-spouse is eligible for COBRA and how to notify them. Do I have to do anything?

nina - People Ops: Good question. When a dependent is removed due to divorce, the ex-spouse is a qualifying beneficiary for COBRA. The plan admin will send a COBRA election notice to the ex-spouses last known address on file. If youd like, attach a forwarding address in the secure portal note. You do not need to manually enroll them.

 sam: I added a forwarding address in the secure note. One more: we had a stepchild listed as dependent from a prior marriage. Are they automatically removed too? I dont want to leave them off unintentionally.

 kevin - Benefits Admin: Dependents stay unless you request removal. If the stepchild remains eligible, we will keep them covered since custody/guardianship matters depend on the document. If you want the stepchild removed, upload the appropriate court order or note the effective date in the portal. Otherwise we'll keep them on the plan.

 hr-bot: Submission received. Case ID: QLE-20261012-311. People Ops will review within 2 business days.

 nina - People Ops: I see the case and the decree. Ill submit the removal to the carrier with effective date 2026-10-01 and request retro premium credit for Aug/Sept. Kevin/Dylan  please flag for carrier premium reconciliation and COBRA notice.

 kevin - Benefits Admin: Flagged. Ill submit the request to the carrier and update this thread once they respond. If carrier issues a credit well coordinate the refund or payroll credit.

 dylan - Payroll: Noted. If carrier provides refund well process a net refund to you unless you prefer a payroll credit applied to upcoming deductions. Let us know preference when we have the amount.

 sam: Thanks all, appreciate the quick help. Please keep me posted here. :pray:
